en.app.name: StorageLens
en.common.error: This action could not be completed. {reason}
en.scan.title: Scan your storage
en.scan.quickHelp: Common shared folders, up to two levels. Fast and partial.
en.scan.deepHelp: Recursively measure accessible shared storage. Private app folders remain protected.
en.scan.cancelled: Scan cancelled. Previous completed results were kept.
en.scan.partial: Partial measurement: {errors} inaccessible or excluded locations.
en.scan.empty: Run a scan to see measured folders and large files.
en.scan.limit: The scan reached its time or entry limit. Select a smaller folder for more detail.
en.scan.chooseHelp: Use the Android folder picker for a specific folder. Grants stay under your control.
en.overview.title: Your storage, in focus.
en.overview.description: A clear picture of your phone, with real measurements and visible limits.
en.overview.grantUsage: Allow usage access to measure app data and cache.
en.overview.sharedWarning: Shared storage and app data can overlap. Do not add these totals together.
en.apps.title: Apps, unpacked.
en.apps.description: Include system, disabled and packages without a launcher icon.
en.apps.name: Name
en.apps.dataHelp: Data includes cache. Total = app files + data; cache is not added twice. Packages sharing an Android UID can share reported data.
en.apps.apkOnly: APK size only · private data unavailable
en.apps.permission: App storage unavailable · allow Usage access
en.apps.statsUnavailable: Android did not report storage for this package. Its data may be protected, shared or temporarily unavailable.
en.apps.uninstallHelp: Android asks you to confirm. Uninstalling can remove app data and sign-ins.
en.apps.systemProtected: System and StorageLens packages are protected from uninstall here.
en.files.title: Follow the footprint.
en.files.description: Browse the folders measured in your saved scan.
en.files.deleteHelp: App-private data must be managed by its app. StorageLens does not permanently delete folders.
en.files.trashHelp: Android will ask before moving supported shared media to its recoverable trash.
en.files.noTrash: This file is not eligible for Android media trash. Use Files to manage it.
en.files.trashDone: Android completed the media review. Rescan to refresh measurements.
en.review.title: Review with context.
en.review.description: Inventory signals help you investigate. They are not malware verdicts.
en.review.warning: StorageLens is not an antivirus. It cannot guarantee discovery of hidden malware, rootkits or private data outside OS permissions.
en.review.noLauncherHelp: Often services, keyboards, plugins or system components. A missing icon does not mean malware.
en.review.sideloadHelp: May include preinstalled, sideloaded or restored apps. Review names and permissions before acting.
en.review.cacheHelp: Use each app's storage settings. Cache may be recreated; some offline content may need downloading again.
en.review.playProtectHelp: Use your device's supported security scanner for malware checks.
en.access.title: Access, without guesswork.
en.access.description: Grant only the access you want. Measurements explain what remains unavailable.
en.access.usageHelp: Allows Android to report app, data and cache sizes for visible packages. No file contents are read.
en.access.filesHelp: Allows shared-storage scanning. Other apps' internal files and Android/data remain protected.
en.access.coverageHelp: Work profiles, other users, inaccessible volumes, unregistered code and OS-protected directories may be missing. Package visibility is limited to what Android reports.
en.access.offlineHelp: No Internet permission, telemetry, account or cloud backup. Scan records stay in this app's private storage.
en.access.grantsHelp: You can revoke a saved folder grant in Android settings or choose another folder.
en.errors.notReady: The native storage bridge is not available. Reopen the installed app.
en.errors.permission: This operation needs an Android storage grant. Open Access & limits.
en.errors.busy: Another scan or native request is running. Wait for it to finish.
en.errors.invalid: The request was rejected. Refresh the screen and try again.
en.errors.failed: Android could not complete the operation. Check access and try again.
en.errors.webview: Update Android System WebView to use StorageLens.
en.windows.title: StorageLens — Local storage manager
en.windows.launchFailure: StorageLens could not start. Details were saved to its local log. {reason}
en.windows.runtime: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required. Install it from Microsoft's official website, then reopen StorageLens.
en.windows.closeBusy: A local file operation is finishing. Wait a moment, then close the window again.
en.windows.invalidData: Choose a StorageLens data folder containing storage.sqlite3. Your existing records have not been changed.
en.windows.aboutBody: StorageLens {version} preview. Local storage inspection and reviewed cleanup. No cloud deployment required. App-folder associations can overlap. This is not an antivirus.
en.security.title: Security & inventory review
en.security.subtitle: Registered packages and OS security status, with visible coverage limits.
en.security.disabled: Real-time protection not reported as enabled
en.security.unavailable: Defender status unavailable. Another security product or Windows policy may control protection.
en.security.requested: A quick scan was requested from Microsoft Defender. Check Windows Security for progress and findings.
en.security.notice: StorageLens inventories registered applications and measured folders. It does not certify a device as malware-free or detect every hidden executable. Use your OS security scanner for threat detection.
en.security.sizeHelp: Related folders are measured associations, not exact uninstall savings. Shared data can appear for multiple applications. Enable system components in Applications to inspect framework registrations.
en.move.title: Give your files a new home.
en.move.subtitle: Review personal files that could live on another drive, then choose their destination.
en.move.intro: Suggestions use saved measurements, not proof that a file is unused. Choose files you recognize. Review rechecks their current contents.
en.move.empty: No matching large personal files in this snapshot. Scan your profile first, or use Review move in Folder explorer or Largest files.
en.move.media: Personal media; players and playlists may need the new path.
en.move.documents: Personal documents or downloads; shortcuts and saved references may need updating.
en.move.newFolderHelp: StorageLens creates a new child folder. Existing folders and files are never merged or overwritten.
en.move.driveHelp: Choose a connected drive different from every selected source. This version supports NTFS destinations.
en.move.impact: Files leave their current paths after copying and verification. Shortcuts, playlists, project references and apps that use those paths may need updating. Windows library locations are not changed. Check destination folder access before moving private files.
en.move.recovery: Originals are moved to Windows Recycle Bin only after the copies and named file streams pass SHA-256 verification. Space remains occupied in the bin until you remove those originals in Windows.
en.move.space: Immediate space freed: 0 B. Up to {size} may be released after reviewing and removing the recycled originals in Windows.
en.move.copyConsent: Moving reads the selected file contents to copy and verify them. Scanning itself continues to read metadata only.
en.move.agree: I reviewed the destinations, consequences and Recycle Bin behavior.
en.move.partial: If cancelled, interrupted or blocked, destination copies are kept. Check both locations; already recycled entries are listed below. StorageLens never permanently deletes originals.
en.move.complete: Completed. Rescan the source and destination to update saved measurements.
en.move.cancelled: Cancelled. Check the destination copies and the recorded originals below.
en.move.failed: The move stopped. Review both locations before retrying.
en.move.interrupted: Interrupted. Check the destination and Recycle Bin before retrying. No automatic retry or permanent-delete fallback runs.
en.move.errorPath: Choose an existing local file or folder without links, device paths or cloud placeholders.
en.move.errorProtected: This location is protected from relocation. Choose individual personal files or subfolders; keep Windows, installed programs, app state and broad library containers in place.
en.move.errorProject: This selection contains or belongs to a development project. Relocate it using your project tools after backing up uncommitted work.
en.move.errorDestination: Choose an ordinary destination folder outside Windows, installed apps and StorageLens data.
en.move.errorFilesystem: This version requires an NTFS destination so named streams, including download security metadata, can be preserved.
en.move.errorName: Enter a new folder name of up to 80 characters, without reserved names, trailing dots/spaces or path separators.
en.move.errorLimit: This selection exceeds the review limit of 25,000 entries or 30 seconds. Choose smaller child folders.
en.move.errorSpecial: This selection contains unsupported system, encrypted, linked, shared-hard-link or special-stream data. Use its owning app or Explorer.
en.move.errorSelection: Choose 1?25 distinct selections without including both a parent and its child.
en.move.errorCollision: A target name already exists or selected items have the same name. Choose another new folder name or review them separately.
en.move.errorSameDrive: Choose a different drive from every selected source. Moving within the same drive does not relieve its storage use.
en.move.errorSpace: The destination needs enough available space for all logical file streams plus a safety margin.
en.move.errorBusy: Wait for the current scan, cleanup or move to finish.
en.move.errorHistory: Move history could not be read safely. Review local logs and data before continuing.
en.move.errorNoJob: There is no active move in this window to cancel.
en.move.errorConfirm: Type MOVE exactly and review the agreement before confirming.
en.move.errorExpired: This move review expired or was already used. Review it again.
en.move.errorChanged: The source or destination changed after review. Originals that were not already recycled are retained; inspect the recorded locations.
en.move.errorVerification: Copy verification failed. Originals that were not already recycled are retained. Review the destination copies before trying again.
en.move.errorOperation: Windows could not finish copying, verifying or recycling. Originals that were not already recycled are retained; inspect both locations.
